question:
Select the most appropriate word for the given group of words.

A person who likes humankind and human society
solution:
The correct answer is "**Philanthropist**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Among the given options, the word in option 1 can replace the given phrase.
 
 
• **"Philanthropist" is a noun that refers to a person who likes humankind and human society, and who actively promotes their welfare.**(लोकोपकारक)

 
 
• Example: Bill Gates is known for his philanthropy, having donated billions of dollars to various charitable causes.
 
 
 
 
 
• Thus, the word "Philanthropist" can substitute the given group of words.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 2 (Lunatic) refers to a person who is mentally ill or unstable.(पागल मनुष्य)
 
• Option 3 (Narcissist) refers to a person who is excessively self-centered and obsessed with their own appearance or achievements.(आत्ममुग्ध)
 
• Option 4 (Mercenary) refers to a person who is primarily motivated by money or other material gain, rather than by ethical or moral considerations.(लोभी)
